A first stop before [Classic Synths Compared](synth-compare.qmd). Short sections, one idea each. Click a heading to fold or open it.

::: {.ik-do}
**What you'll do**

1. Read what the Sub 37 is and when it was made.
2. Learn its sound, one idea at a time.
3. Take a guided tour: press each **▶ Hear step** button and listen for one change.
4. Find records it is on.
5. Check yourself with a short quiz.
:::

## What it is

- The **Sub 37** is an analog synth made by **Moog Music** from **2014**; the **Subsequent 37** followed in 2017 (Wikipedia, "Moog Sub 37").
- Its own manual could not be found, so the panel follows the **Subsequent 25**, a smaller synth of the same family (Subsequent 25 manual).

## Its sound

- **Two oscillators** whose waves sweep from triangle to saw to square to narrow pulse (Subsequent 25 manual, PDF p. 13).
- A **sub oscillator** one octave below oscillator 1 (manual, PDF p. 15).
- **MultiDrive** overdrives the sound before the filter (manual, PDF p. 16).
- **Duo mode** plays two notes at once through the one filter (manual, PDF p. 9).

## The panel

This is the Sub 37 panel from [Classic Synths Compared](synth-compare.qmd), drawn after the real one (not a copy). Play it from the keys under the panel, the computer keys (a w s e d f t g y h u j k) or a MIDI keyboard. Turn any knob while you play. The sound is this site's own model; nobody has compared it with the real instrument.

## Guided tour

Each step loads a worked example and changes one thing.

```{=html}
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="sub37-drive" data-set="{&quot;mSub&quot;:0,&quot;drive&quot;:0}"><p><b>One oscillator.</b> Sub and drive off. Listen: a plain bass.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="sub37-drive" data-set="{&quot;drive&quot;:0}"><p><b>Add the sub.</b> Sub oscillator at 7. Listen: deeper.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="sub37-drive"><p><b>MultiDrive.</b> Drive at 4. Listen: warmer and grittier.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="sub37-duo" data-set="{&quot;duo&quot;:false}"><p><b>Mono.</b> Duo off: one note at a time.</p></div>
<div class="ik-step" data-ex="sub37-duo"><p><b>Duo mode.</b> Two notes through one filter. Listen: two-note intervals.</p></div>
```

## Check yourself

Click an answer. You will see at once if it is right. Nothing is saved or sent.

```{=html}
<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>Duo mode plays…</b></p><ul><li>Two notes through one filter</li><li>Two songs</li><li>Drums and bass</li><li>Only noise</li></ul><p class="ik-why">Manual PDF p. 9.</p></div>
<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>The sub oscillator is…</b></p><ul><li>One octave below oscillator 1</li><li>An octave above</li><li>A drum</li><li>A filter</li></ul><p class="ik-why">Manual PDF p. 15.</p></div>
<div class="ik-q" data-a="0"><p><b>MultiDrive…</b></p><ul><li>Overdrives the sound</li><li>Adds reverb</li><li>Records audio</li><li>Changes tempo</li></ul><p class="ik-why">Manual PDF p. 16.</p></div>
<div class="ik-q" data-a="2"><p><b>Which year did the Sub 37 come out?</b></p><ul><li>1970</li><li>1983</li><li>2014</li><li>2024</li></ul><p class="ik-why">Wikipedia.</p></div>
```
